note: 2026-10-25 initial assessment: crypto-bigint 0.5.5 reaches the workspace only transitively through the RustCrypto curve family (crypto-bigint is consumed by elliptic-curve 0.13.8, reached via p256 0.13.2 / p384 0.13.1 / primeorder 0.13.6) under openidconnect 4.0.1, and only for OIDC ECDSA (P-256 and P-384) signature verification in crates/sandhi-proxy/src/auth.rs. RUSTSEC-2026-0387 is timing variability in integer operations intended to be constant-time; exploitation requires high-resolution timing observation of the gateway's token-verification path by an attacker positioned on the trust boundary — the same reviewed-usage threat model and adapter as RUSTSEC-2023-0071 (docs/security/oidc-rsa-advisory.json). No patched in-range upgrade exists: the advisory's fix requires crypto-bigint >=0.7.6, which needs elliptic-curve >=0.14 / p384 >=0.14, while openidconnect 4.0.1 (latest published) pins the 0.13 curve family. Reassess when openidconnect ships a 0.14-compatible release; the record expires in 24 days regardless.
